why: The student traces every method with values in call order (finalAdjust → reCalculate → update → num2), which is a line-by-line, value-by-value trace, not a statement of purpose (so not L3) and more than one part or a bare rule (so not L1). The one mistake—taking the v+6 branch for -1 instead of v-9 (correct result is -10, giving -5, num2 = 20)—is a single slip in an otherwise rule-correct trace, so it is L2 with an error.
